$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. LoopDefinition per LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §2.2/§3 (FB-RAT-LOOP-001), node contracts per §4 (FB-RAT-LOOP-002, eight categories — see Amendment 1 in that document for how the base pack's five grew to eight), gateway contracts per §5 (FB-RAT-LOOP-003), budgets per §18, verification/terminal-state per §16/§9. This is the FIRST LoopDefinition schema this repository has ever emitted — no v1 exists anywhere under schemas/ (repo-wide search confirmed empty, matching WP-1's correct decision to skip it; the '.v2' in this filename echoes the spec document's own v2.1 numbering, not a supersession of a prior schema file). Node/gateway/edge shapes are folded into this SAME file as $defs, not split into separate node.schema.json/gateway.schema.json files, per the merged-artifact instruction that the semantic/package digest covers a LoopDefinition as one unit (semantic-digest.v1.json). Byte-level container/digest/canonicalization/capability/model-vocabulary concepts are cross-referenced from the four (plus two supporting) frozen registries under schemas/loops/registries/ and are NOT redefined here — a conflict between this schema and a registry is this schema's error, the registry wins, per LOOP_FROZEN_CONCEPTS_WP1L_G0.md. Small shared sub-shapes (AuthorityRung, ExecutionTargetType, provenance minimum) are duplicated locally as $defs per this repo's established convention (see schemas/execution/receipt.schema.json), not cross-file $ref'd.
title: LoopDefinition
description: The canonical, semantic graph of a loop (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §2.2): identity, semantic version, typed inputs/outputs, nodes, edges, gateways, budgets, typed binding slots, required capabilities, execution-target and distribution constraints, engine compatibility range, verification policy, terminal-state mapping, provenance, and license. Serializable independently of UI layout — 'presentation'/'layout'/'x'/'y'/'notes' keys at any depth are excluded from semanticDigest by semantic-digest.v1.json's exclusionListV1, not enforced by this schema (exclusion is a digest-computation-time concern, not a structural one). Typically the payload validated against directly (not wrapped in dev.fonebrew.contracts.common.ContractEnvelope in the on-disk package form — floop-container-format.v1.json's definition.json is this schema's root object verbatim).

loopId.description: Identifies a loop family and is stable across releases owned by the same publisher (§14). Not itself content-addressed — packageContentDigest (floop-container-format.v1.json) is the byte-level identity; loopId is the human/publisher-facing family identity a release identity tuple {loopId, semanticVersion, packageDigest, publisherKeyFingerprint} builds on (§14).

semanticVersion.description: SemVer (§14). A breaking input/output, authority, side-effect, verifier, or compatibility change requires a major version bump even when the visible graph changes only slightly.

documentationRef.description: Reference to human-readable documentation — typically a package-relative path under docs/ (floop-container-format.v1.json's optional docs/ directory) or a URI. Null when the objective string alone is the only documentation this definition carries. Package docs/ content is untrusted and subject to prompt-static-scanning/invisible-Unicode rejection at build/import time (§25, LOOP-PKG-006/008) — not re-enforced by this schema, which only carries the reference.

inputSchema.description: Typed input JSON Schema (§3, §16 — draft 2020-12 or later ratified version; LOOP-SCHEMA-002).

startNodeId.description: The node a run begins at (§3 'start and terminal nodes'). MUST equal some entry in `nodes[].nodeId` — this schema cannot enforce that cross-reference structurally (JSON Schema has no array-membership-by-computed-value keyword); a definition with a dangling startNodeId is schema-valid but LOOP-GRAPH-001 ('missing start or terminal paths') invalid — see fixtures/loops/loop-definition.v2/adversarial/.

terminalNodeIds.description: Nodes that legitimately end a run (§3). Same cross-reference caveat as startNodeId — reachability from startNodeId to at least one of these is a graph-traversal obligation the validator performs (LOOP-GRAPH-001/002), not something this schema checks.

nodes.description: §4. `uniqueItems` is deliberately NOT used here: JSON Schema's uniqueItems requires whole-item deep-equality, so it cannot catch two distinct node objects that merely share the same `nodeId` while differing elsewhere — that is exactly the LOOP-ID-001 ('duplicate identity') case a real validator must catch by walking the array itself. See fixtures/loops/loop-definition.v2/adversarial/duplicate-node-id.adversarial.json.

edges.description: §5. Every non-gateway control-flow connection between nodes.

bindingSlots.description: §2.6: typed abstract slots a BindingProfile resolves locally (FB-RAT-WEB-005 — packages declare slots, Fonebrew resolves them; binding profiles are not publishable package content, so no resolved value ever appears here).

requiredCapabilities.description: Definition-wide union of every node's requestedCapabilities (capability-ids.v1.json reverse-DNS namespace), duplicated at the top level for a compatibility evaluator that wants a quick capability set without walking every node (LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md axis 4). Capability requests are REQUESTS, never grants (§10).

minEngineVersion.description: Minimum tested engine range bound (capability-ids.v1.json `engineVersion` object — `definition`/`v1Value`/`bumpRule`/`declaredAsRange`, not redefined here). v1 engine surface is '1.0.0'.

maxEngineVersion.description: Maximum tested engine range bound, or null for no declared upper bound. Field MUST be present (possibly null) — an absent field is ambiguous between 'no upper bound' and 'forgot to declare one'; null is the explicit spelling of the former.

presentation.description: Definition-root presentation/layout metadata. Excluded from semanticDigest at ANY depth by semantic-digest.v1.json's exclusionListV1 (['presentation','layout','x','y','notes']) — that exclusion is structural matching-by-key-name at digest-computation time, not something this schema enforces or needs to mirror.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).

refPath.description: Package-relative path under schemas/ (floop-container-format.v1.json) when location=PACKAGE_RELATIVE_PATH.

inlineSchema.description: An embedded JSON Schema draft 2020-12 (or later ratified version) document when location=INLINE. Not itself validated as a meta-schema by this document — LOOP-SCHEMA-002 is a validator-time obligation.

NodeCategory.description: §4, eight categories. The first five (DETERMINISTIC_TRANSFORMATION, MODEL_INFERENCE, TYPED_TOOL, HUMAN_DECISION, BOUNDED_SUBLOOP) are the base pack's original five (FB-RAT-LOOP-002, renamed/clarified but not changed in kind). VERIFIER, ARTIFACT_IMPORT_EXPORT, and WAIT_EVENT_GATE are the three genuinely new categories §4's Amendment 1 documents — treat all eight as the current set, not the base pack's five, per that amendment.

AuthorityRung.description: capability-ids.v1.json's authorityLadder, duplicated locally per this repo's convention (mirrors contracts/kotlin/AuthorityContracts.kt's AuthorityRung enum) rather than cross-file $ref'd.

ExecutionTargetType.description: schemas/execution/target.schema.json's ExecutionTargetType, duplicated locally (FB-RAT-EXE-010) rather than cross-file $ref'd.

TerminalRunState.description: The eight terminal states of LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §9's 17-state run machine, duplicated locally for definition-time references (terminalStateMapping below) — the full 17-state machine with its non-terminal states belongs to a run/receipt schema, not this definition schema.

FailureTerminalState.description: §9's eight terminal states minus the two success states — the closed set a node's own failure-to-terminal-state mapping (§4) may resolve to.

IdempotencyMode.description: §4 'idempotency mode and key strategy'. PURE: no side effects, safe to re-run unconditionally. IDEMPOTENT_WITH_KEY: side-effecting but safe to retry given the same idempotencyKeyStrategy (mirrors FB-RAT-EXE-008's externalDuplicateBehavior contract at the execution layer). NOT_IDEMPOTENT: retry requires compensation or explicit user confirmation.

SideEffectClass.description: §4 'side-effect classification' — a declared property of the node distinct from authorityClass (a node can request EXECUTE_EXTERNAL authority for a side effect classified PERSISTENT_LOCAL, e.g. a scoped local write mediated through an external tool).

schemaRef.description: Null means untyped/any — MUST NOT be used for a port carrying a value later relied on by a downstream typed schema without an explicit adapter node.

subloopDefinitionRef.description: Package-relative path to an embedded subloop LoopDefinition (§17), when kind=EMBEDDED_SUBLOOP.

referencedPackageDigest.description: packageContentDigest (floop-container-format.v1.json) of the referenced release, when kind=REFERENCED_SUBLOOP (§17 — subloop referenced by immutable package identity).

Compensation.description: §4 'compensation behavior or explicit non-compensability flag'. Structurally operationalizes the shape of LOOP-VERIFY-001 ('destructive path... has no compensation behavior and no explicit non-compensability acknowledgement') — a compensable=false node MUST carry an explicit, non-omittable, true acknowledgement; it is not possible to construct a schema-valid Compensation object that silently omits both. LOOP-VERIFY-001 itself (whether authorityClass=EXECUTE_DESTRUCTIVE nodes carry this object meaningfully) remains a validator-time cross-check against NodeDefinition.authorityClass.

requiredForSuccess.description: §16: when true, this node's declared verifierIds MUST have a passing result tied to the run's inputs/digest/artifacts before a run may claim SUCCEEDED_VERIFIED (LOOP-VERIFY-002).

maxRecursionDepth.description: Required when category=BOUNDED_SUBLOOP (LOOP-BUDGET-002 'recursive subloop... has no statically visible depth limit', enforced below).

requestedModelCapabilityTags.description: Only meaningful when category=MODEL_INFERENCE — tag IDs from model-capability-vocabulary.v1.json (not enumerated here as a closed list since that registry's tags array is additive; a validator cross-checks against the live registry, not this schema).

presentation.description: Excluded from semanticDigest (semantic-digest.v1.json exclusionListV1) — see root `presentation` property's description.

notes.description: Authoring-only note. Excluded from semanticDigest by key name (semantic-digest.v1.json exclusionListV1) regardless of this node's actual semantic content — see that registry's limitationsV1 for why a field that needs to be semantic must avoid this literal key name.

allOf.$comment: §17 'recursive subloops require a statically visible depth limit' (LOOP-BUDGET-002).
A wait/event gate (§4 category 8) MUST declare a statically visible bound, same principle as §17's cycle-bound requirement — an unbounded wait is an unbounded cycle in disguise.

conditionExpression.description: Null marks this outcome as the default/else branch.

priority.description: Priority semantics where relevant (§5); null means unordered/no declared priority among outcomes.

exhaustive.description: §5: an explicit exhaustiveness policy is required.

defaultOrTerminalFailurePath.description: Required non-null when exhaustive=false (enforced below) — LOOP-GRAPH-003 'not exhaustive and declares no default or terminal-failure path'.

gatewayId.description: Non-null when this edge realizes one of a gateway's declared outcomes (§5).

unknownBudgetDimensions.description: §18: unknown budget dimensions are preserved on round trip and treated conservatively by runtimes that cannot enforce them.

Budgets.description: §18: 'Minimum budget dimensions are steps, wall clock, model tokens, monetary cost, and tool calls.' These five are hard runtime boundaries, not estimates — LOOP-BUDGET-001 requires at least these for any node with external side effects.

kind.description: §2.6's exact seven binding-target kinds ('models, repositories, execution targets, devices, secrets, policies, and budgets').

constraints.description: Kind-specific constraint bag — e.g. for MODEL: required model-capability-vocabulary.v1.json tags; for EXECUTION_TARGET: permitted ExecutionTargetType values.

requiresAlwaysOnLocal.description: True forces LOCAL_ANDROID/ConnectivityKind.ALWAYS_ON_LOCAL (schemas/execution/target.schema.json) — no intermittent or remote target may satisfy this definition.

ExecutionTargetConstraints.description: LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md's 'Execution target' axis (axis 6) at declaration time, cross-referenced not redefined.

allowedDistFlavors.description: CLAUDE.md's `dist` dimension. 'play' excludes overlay/screen-capture/USB-host — a definition whose requiredCapabilities imply one of those MUST NOT declare 'play' among allowedDistFlavors (a validator-time cross-check against capability-ids.v1.json, not enforced structurally here).

DistributionConstraints.description: LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md's 'Platform/distribution' axis (axis 7) at declaration time, cross-referenced not redefined.

requireVerificationForSuccess.description: §16 default policy: whether this definition ever claims SUCCEEDED_VERIFIED at all, or is expected to only ever reach SUCCEEDED_UNVERIFIED.

unverifiedSuccessAllowed.description: Whether SUCCEEDED_UNVERIFIED (§9) is an acceptable non-error outcome for this definition, or whether an unverified terminal MUST instead be treated as a failure by any consuming policy.

nodeFailureEscalations.description: Definition-level index of every node's own onFailureTerminalState (§4), so a runtime does not have to walk the full nodes[] array for a run-level summary. A validator MUST cross-check this against each NodeDefinition.onFailureTerminalState for consistency — this schema does not itself enforce that cross-array agreement.

Provenance.description: FB-RAT-COM-008 provenance minimum, duplicated inline per this repo's convention (mirrors schemas/execution/receipt.schema.json's `provenance`) rather than cross-file $ref'd.

spdxId.description: e.g. 'Apache-2.0'. This repository's own license is itself LICENSE-PENDING (docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md) — a definition MAY declare its own spdxId independently of this repo's pending status.

licenseFileRef.description: Package-relative path to a LICENSE file (floop-container-format.v1.json's optional LICENSE entry).

LicenseRef.description: At least one of spdxId/licenseFileRef/customLicenseText MUST be non-null — feeds LOOP-LINEAGE-* checks (§2.9, LOOP_FORK_LINEAGE_CONTRACT.md).
